description: Illustrative AI neural sculpture for the Dither Veil About preview.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square image for an interactive dither-to-color reveal in the About section of an AI engineer's dark blue portfolio. Primary request: a striking abstract artificial intelligence image. Subject: an intricate luminous neural sculpture, a flowing tangle of glasslike optical fibers and tiny interconnected crystalline nodes bending into a three dimensional manifold, fine circuitry within a central liquid-chrome core. Close macro scientific-art rendering, rich dimensional detail at several scales, strong readable silhouette, dark midnight navy backdrop, electric periwinkle and ice blue light with restrained warm amber signals. Dramatic studio rim lighting, sharp center and soft depth of field. Editorial, sophisticated, tactile and physically plausible; interesting in both monochrome dithering and full color. Composition: centered subject, fills most of square with dark breathing space at edges, no writing or UI. No humanoid robot, no brain silhouette, no logos, no letters, no watermark. Opaque background.
